limitations: Build durations are CI wall-clock measurements on one GitHub-hosted runner and are comparative, not product SLAs.
Runtime memory is Chromium JS heap after the 5k table and map are ready; it is a reproducible UI proxy, not total desktop process RSS.
Desktop GUI cold-start time is not claimed from headless CI; useful-render and map-ready timings are measured in the browser harness.
Installer complexity is not measured because this probe intentionally uses a portable shell with bundle.active=false.
